name: Cap signing
summary: A graduation post becomes the mortarboard drawn from above: friends write on it in their own hand with a doodle, the tassel swings each time, and the graduate pins the finished cap to their profile.
useWhen: can we all write on her grad post
make a cap we can sign for calvin's graduation
graduation post, leave her a note
dontUseWhen: a birthday card with a gift pot (use bday-pool)
planning the graduation party itself (use host-board)
a recap of the whole year (use semester-wrapped)

title.description: Card title, sentence case, e.g. 'Sign Maya's cap'

school.description: Line under the title, e.g. 'Eastfield · class of 2027'

year.description: Two digits on the tassel charm, e.g. '27'

notes.description: Signatures already on the cap, oldest first, in the friends' own words (28 characters or fewer)

text.description: What they wrote, lowercase is fine

lines.description: 1 to 6 suggested lines shown in the empty box; Sign uses it if nothing is typed
